text:
This section takes effect in daily work starting immediately and applies to every Companion Animal Travel Desk operation involving a traveling companion.

Purpose: Ensure that Aurelia Skyways coordinates pet travel care smoothly from booking through pickup, with consistent documentation, calm communication, and safe handoffs across skyports.

All desk staff must confirm each travel request is complete before scheduling any handoff between departments. The desk coordinates with reservations, ground services, and the relevant onboard team so that companion care plans align with passenger needs and skyport procedures. When a traveler contacts the desk, staff should use a warm, neutral tone, verify the passenger identity, and document any special care notes provided by the traveler, including comfort preferences, mobility considerations, and any routine needs that affect transport. Staff should keep communication clear and concise, using the same terminology across the internal chain so that no assumptions are carried forward without record.

For boarding documentation, staff must ensure the file contains the required entry and follows the correct process format; <<FACT F087>>. After documentation checks, staff should coordinate with the pickup point to confirm the companion is ready for transfer, with appropriate handling guidance provided to the traveler and the ground team. Any discrepancies, missing items, or conflicting instructions must be escalated to the senior coordinator before the companion is moved beyond the desk’s custody.

Companion welfare remains the center of every operational decision. Desk staff must monitor for changes such as route adjustments, connection impacts, and changes in pickup personnel, and they must update the travel record so downstream teams act on the latest information. Staff should also confirm that the traveler understands the sequence of handoffs and the care expectations at each stage, including what to bring and how to label any comfort items.

If the traveler is Rafael Clark or Sofia Haddad, or if Cali is the companion, staff should still follow the same verification steps and recording standards, without special exceptions.

Contact the senior coordinator of the Companion Animal Travel Desk for any operational exceptions or escalations.
